source_reviews.rights_and_reuse_note: Publisher-hosted open fulltext was reviewed. History Go stores only bibliographic identity, paraphrased computational findings, method parameters and section/table locators; article text and figures are not redistributed.

locators.pages: Description; Data Files; metadata field definitions
locators.section: Version, provenance, format and sample structure
locators.supports: TinySOL v6 inneholder 2913 isolerte enkelttoner fra 14 instrumenter, opprinnelig tatt opp ved IRCAM 1996–1999; filene er mono WAV, 44,1 kHz, 16-bit, 2–10 sekunder, og metadata oppgir instrument, pitch, dynamikk, instance og om digital retuning var nødvendig.
TinySOL v6 er CC BY 4.0 med DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3685367; TinySOL.tar.gz har MD5 36030a7fe389da86c3419e5ee48e3b7f og metadatafilen MD5 a86c9bb115f69e61f2f25872e397fc4a.

source_reviews.rights_and_reuse_note: Zenodo-dokumentasjonen er gjennomgått for identitet, tekniske metadata og rettigheter. CC BY 4.0 tillater gjenbruk med attribusjon; denne piloten velger likevel external-link-and-metadata-only som History Go-leveransemodus.

rights.license_source: TinySOL v6 Zenodo Conditions of Use
rights.decision: TinySOL permits reuse under CC BY 4.0, including commercial reuse with attribution. This evidence production deliberately stores only dataset identity, file locators, measurement metadata and external links; embedded playback can be considered separately.

claim_records.statement: I Gonzalez og Pratis TinySOL-klassifikasjon med Random Forest behandles pp, mf og ff som dynamikkklasser; ved 99 prosent signifikansnivå rapporterer de at FFT-Acoustic-koeffisientene er bedre for klassifikasjon etter dynamikk enn de sammenlignede Librosa-trekkene.
locators: Gonzalez & Prati 2023, Section 4: TinySOL via mirdata; dynamics pp/mf/ff; Random Forest classification
Gonzalez & Prati 2023, Section 4/Table 1 discussion: 99% significance and better dynamics classification relative to compared Librosa features

object_scope.published_method: Random Forest with FFT-Acoustic descriptors compared against selected Librosa timbral features; paired T-test used for classwise statistical comparison

claim_records.uncertainty: Claimet gjengir et publisert, datasett- og metodeavhengig klassifikasjonsresultat. History Go har ikke rerunnet Random-Forest-eksperimentet, og de to frigitte fløytefilene er inspeksjonsankre for datasettet, ikke en selvstendig replikasjon av aggregate performance.
claim_records.prohibited_inference: Resultatet kan ikke brukes som bevis for at dynamikk er en naturlig, universell eller instrumentuavhengig klangkategori, eller at FFT-Acoustic alltid er bedre enn andre feature-sett utenfor det rapporterte TinySOL-oppsettet.

reproducibility.parameter_status: core FFT normalization, amplitude threshold, classifier and statistical-comparison description recovered; exact full model hyperparameterization not independently reconstructed in this production

boundary_records.statement: Dynamikkklassene og FFT-/Librosa-representasjonene er operative kategorier i et bestemt datasett og klassifikasjonsoppsett; statistisk klassifiserbarhet gjør dem ikke til universelle eller naturlige klangkategorier.
locators: Gonzalez & Prati 2023, Section 4 classification design and Section 5 conclusions
boundary_records.release_effect: Blocks universal timbre-taxonomy wording and claims that a model category is an intrinsic musical truth.

boundary_records.statement: FFT-Acoustic-resultatet avhenger av TinySOL-utvalget, feature-definisjonene, FFT-behandlingen, Random-Forest-oppsettet og den rapporterte statistiske sammenligningen; History Go har ikke gjennomført en uavhengig rerun.
locators: Gonzalez & Prati 2023, Sections 2 and 4; Table 1 discussion
boundary_records.release_effect: Blocks wording that treats the reported ranking against Librosa as parameter-free, dataset-independent or independently replicated by History Go.

boundary_records.statement: TinySOL v6 is CC BY 4.0 and allows reuse with attribution, but this production uses only external links and metadata. The released C4 flute pp/ff windows are inspection anchors and do not by themselves support population-level claims about all instruments, pitches or dynamics.
locators: TinySOL v6 Zenodo: Description; Data Files; Conditions of Use; Files and checksums
boundary_records.release_effect: Keeps rights explicit and blocks generalization from the two inspectable sample windows to the full TinySOL classification population.

resolved: TinySOL v6 persistent identity, DOI, archive checksum, recording provenance and audio format verified
two matched flute C4 ordinary-technique audio windows fixed at pp and ff with exact archive paths and 0.000–2.000 s intervals
CC BY 4.0 rights are compatible with attributed reuse; this production deliberately chooses external_link_and_metadata_only
direct_object_gate.release_rule: Only the published Gonzalez & Prati TinySOL dynamics-classification claim may drive a question. The direct audio windows support dataset inspection, not independent replication; parameter dependence, dataset scope and rights boundaries must be preserved.

coverage.known_gap: Produksjonen verifiserer ett beregningsresultat om klang/dynamikk i TinySOL og to matched fløytesamples som object anchors. Den dekker ikke orkestral tekstur, romakustikk, kulturell klangbetydning eller en uavhengig rerun av klassifikatoren.
